current_activity: Gerow takes command of the Fifteenth Army, which is still handling only rear-echelon tasks
notes: Event date: 16 January 1945 (Wikipedia, Fifteenth Army: Maj. Gen. Gerow assumed command on 16 January 1945; Last Offensive ch. 2 p. 46: Huebner took over V Corps from Gerow, who left to head the Fifteenth Army; ww2byday lists the Fifteenth Army commander as Gerow from 16 January). Event definition: the army's command passes from Maj. Gen. Gilbert R. Porter, who assumed command on 2 January, to Lt. Gen. Leonard T. Gerow. Relationship: no higher headquarters is given by a source read for this row, so none is recorded. Location: Suippes, the Fifteenth Army headquarters (Ferme de Suippes) since 24 December 1944; the headquarters at the time is inferred from that date. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Suippes. Event support: moderate (three sources agree on Gerow and the date). Location support: low (the headquarters place is a December 1944 date carried forward; it is an inference).
